lines.text: Every headline wants something from you.
It wants you angry. Afraid. Envious.
Because every negative word buys a few more clicks.
It reads the headlines on any page, and shows you exactly how they hook you.
Then, one click. The noise is gone. The news stays.
It runs on your device, with Gemini Nano. Private. And free.
Food has a label. Now, your feed does too.
Debait. Read the news, not the bait.
